title: A contract you are about to sign

items.title: The parties are identified
items.look_for: Full names and addresses of everyone signing
items.why_it_matters: You need to know exactly who you are dealing with
items.question_to_ask: Who exactly is the other party to this?

items.title: What each side must do is stated
items.look_for: The main obligations on both sides
items.why_it_matters: The obligations are what you are actually agreeing to
items.question_to_ask: What am I committing to do?

items.title: Amounts and payment dates are stated
items.look_for: Amounts in digits and words, and when each is due
items.why_it_matters: Money terms are where disputes usually begin
items.question_to_ask: How much is payable and when?

items.title: The start and end are stated
items.look_for: Commencement date, term and any renewal
items.why_it_matters: An automatic renewal can extend a deal you wanted to end
items.question_to_ask: When does this start and end, and does it renew?

items.title: How to end it is stated
items.look_for: Notice required, and grounds for ending it early
items.why_it_matters: You want a way out that you can actually use
items.question_to_ask: How can each of us end this?

items.title: Penalties and interest are stated
items.look_for: Charges for late performance or late payment
items.why_it_matters: Penalties can be larger than the underlying amount
items.question_to_ask: What happens if I am late?

items.title: Any indemnity is limited
items.look_for: A promise to cover the other side's losses, and any cap
items.why_it_matters: An uncapped indemnity is an open-ended liability
items.question_to_ask: Can we put a cap on this?

items.title: Liability is capped
items.look_for: A maximum amount either side can be made to pay
items.why_it_matters: A cap turns an unknown risk into a known one
items.question_to_ask: What is the maximum I could be liable for?

items.title: Confidentiality is addressed
items.look_for: What must be kept confidential and for how long
items.why_it_matters: It affects what you may say about the deal afterwards
items.question_to_ask: What can I say about this arrangement?

items.title: Where disputes are heard is stated
items.look_for: A named city, court or arbitration process
items.why_it_matters: A distant forum makes a small dispute expensive
items.question_to_ask: Where would a dispute be heard?

items.title: How changes are made is stated
items.look_for: A requirement that changes be in writing and signed
items.why_it_matters: It prevents a later disagreement about what was agreed
items.question_to_ask: How do we record a change to this?

items.title: Signature and witness requirements are clear
items.look_for: Who signs, whether witnesses are needed and whether stamping applies
items.why_it_matters: An improperly executed document is harder to rely on
items.question_to_ask: What needs to happen for this to be properly signed?

suggested_questions: What am I committing to do?
How can I end this agreement?
What is the maximum I could be liable for?
What happens if I am late?
Where would a dispute be heard?

scenarios.title: I cannot do what I promised
The other side does not do their part
I want to end the agreement early

facts_to_have_ready: The date you signed and when performance was due
What has been done and paid so far
What has gone wrong, with dates
Messages between you and the other party
documents_to_bring: The signed agreement and any annexures
Proof of payments made or received
Any written notice sent or received
Records of what was delivered or performed
